notes: Partial report ('Промежуточный отчет') — biochemistry, lipid panel and one immunology
assay. Deliberately does NOT contain a CBC, so checkup item ...0008 (ОАК) must stay
uncompleted. That is the negative this case exists to catch.
The three printed dates deliberately differ: забора 06.03, регистрации 07.03, печати 11.03.
record_date must be the collection date, per the classify instruction that it is 'the date
the document describes, not the date it was scanned' (stages/classify.ts:19-23). Picking
either of the other two is a specific, detectable failure rather than a near miss.
what_this_case_exercises: record_date from a header table rather than prose, with three competing candidate dates
two section headings (Биохимические / Липидограмма) feeding one flat observation list
Cyrillic unit strings against a Latin-keyed accepted_units map
Cyrillic 'В' in 'Витамин В12' against the Latin-'b' synonym list
four analytes absent from observation_catalog -> obs_code null, is_applied false
'!' out-of-range markers on two rows, one of which is high-is-good (HDL)
trailing guidance prose that must not become observations, findings or conditions
one existing condition the document positively resolves, against four it does not

must_resolve: cond-...0001 Дефицит витамина B12 — the document carries Витамин В12 = 704 пг/мл against
a printed reference of 187–883, i.e. an in-range value for the exact analyte that defines
the condition. This is the one positive: reconcile sees observations (name, code, value,
unit, status) in its extracted summary (stages/reconcile.ts:90-97), so the evidence is
must_not_resolve: cond-...0002 Железодефицитная анемия — the near miss. Adjacent to B12 in a clinician's
mind, but this report contains no haemoglobin, no ferritin, no CBC at all. Resolving it
means generalising from one normal vitamin to a different deficiency.
cond-...0003 Неалкогольная жировая болезнь печени — АЛТ, АСТ and ГГТ are all in range,
which is the trap: normal liver enzymes do not resolve hepatic steatosis, which is an
imaging and histology diagnosis. Note УЗИ печени is checkup ...0002 and is NOT completed
cond-...0004 Дислипидемия — every lipid value sits inside its reference range, so this
looks resolvable. It is not: an in-range panel is evidence of control, not of resolution,
and the document states no resolution. See judgement_calls.
cond-...0005 Хронический гастрит — nothing in a biochemistry or lipid panel bears on it.
The plain 'absence of a mention is not evidence of resolution' case (reconcile.ts:159).

judgement_calls: checkup ...0004 'Глюкоза натощак' is scored as completed even though the report never
says fasting. Glucose was drawn as part of a routine panel and that is how a person would
read it. If the scorer disagrees in practice, this is the entry to revisit first.
checkup ...0001 'Липидный профиль (детально)' and ...0003 'Общий холестерин' both complete
from the same panel; the detailed profile subsumes the single analyte.
Дислипидемия is the most arguable expectation in this case. A reviewer could reasonably
hold that a fully in-range lipid panel resolves it. Scored as unresolved because a single
in-range panel under management shows control rather than resolution, and because the
opposite reading makes the pipeline willing to close chronic conditions off one good day.
If this expectation is flipped, flip it deliberately and record it here.
known_pipeline_bugs_encoded: value_canonical for Витамин В12 is 519.552 pmol/L (704 pg/mL x 0.738), which is the CORRECT
answer, not the answer the pipeline currently produces. See README.md 'Known divergence'.
